independence_evidence: Site copyright and privacy policy name the owner as Design Media LLC, the small company behind the podcast and magazine founded by its host; no media-group parent is named. Several cover editions carry brand or partner names (Boucheron, Poliform, Formafantasma), which suggests partnership funding.
qualifies_reason: Independently owned US print title with hardcover Issue 02 (Spring 2026) and Issue 03 (Fall 2026) on sale from the publisher's own shop.
what_it_is: A hardcover, linen-bound magazine that grew out of a design and luxury-lifestyle interview podcast, with around 400 pages per volume of long interviews, commissioned photography and travel dispatches covering interiors, architecture, fashion, jewellery, art, food and hotels. Each issue appears in several cover editions, often tied to a featured designer or brand, and the Fall 2026 volume includes conversations with Dries Van Noten, Smiljan Radić Clarke and Dominique Crenn. It is aimed at affluent readers and design professionals who follow the high end of interiors, craft and travel and want a collectible book-like object rather than a newsstand glossy.
